text:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling a nighttime maintenance window for the swarm pool (us-west1). 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rolling host reboots + NIC microcode patch. Expect <=10% capacity impact; we'll backfill from gradient-dedicated. ops: please review.
kevin: timeline sounds good. can we run a 2-host canary first (15m) before full roll?
sara: +1 to canary. also need to ensure embeddings batch jobs are low during that window.
maria: canary plan: cordon -> drain (grace 120s) -> reboot -> verify tail latency -> uncordon. ops-bot will kick canary. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/swarm-nightly-v1
jordan: current headroom in us-west1 is ~18% spare GPUs outside reserved commits. after canary expect ~12% headroom. I'll reserve apac-burst pool as emergency fallback.
lee: quick cost check — using apac-burst/dedicated for fallback will incur approx $120/hr. finance ok with up to $250 for the window?
maria: finance gave a green light for up to $250. fallback only if throughput or tail latency crosses thresholds.
kevin: I'll also push a temporary routing rule to prefer quantized-fallback for non-SLA tenants during the window to reduce unit cost and pressure. snippet:
```sh
redwood route update --pool swarm --fallback quantized-llama-13b-fallback
```
sara: make sure we kick a KV cache reseed after each host comes back. add `kvseed delay=30s` to the playbook so prefixes are warmed.
maria: good call — ops-bot will annotate timeline and run kvseed 2m after uncordon for each host.
ops-bot: Scheduled: canary at 02:00 UTC (2 hosts), roll start 02:20 UTC, expected end 04:00 UTC. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/swarm-nightly-v1. I will post job IDs to this thread when tasks start.
jordan: customer comms? any pinned tenants affected?
maria: priority tenants (fin-*, med-*) are pinned to dedicated and won't move. no public SLA hits expected. I'll send a short note to #customer-success with the internal summary.
kevin: if we see sustained latency regression, plan B is to pause roll and failover routes to gradient-dedicated + quantized-fallback. ops runbook has the toggle.
sara: noted. I'll quiet down scheduled embedding batches between 01:30-05:00 UTC to minimize risk.
lee: :thumbsup: cost team will reconcile charges post-window.
kevin: thanks everyone — I'll prep the routing patch and smoke test the canary steps in staging at 00:30 UTC.
maria: thanks — will post final go/no-go at 01:45 UTC in this thread.
